en.title: About Awesome NSH: Verification & Safety Policy
en.metaDescription: Maintainer details for AkaraChen, how scratch-app nsh 0.7.1 install checks work, build.rs and proc-macro security boundaries, and contribution rules.
en.h1: About Awesome NSH: Maintainer, Verification Scope & Safety Policy
en.lead: Transparent documentation of who curates Awesome NSH, how entries are discovered and tested against nsh 0.7.1, and where verification boundaries stop.

who.heading: Who Maintains Awesome NSH
paragraphs: Awesome NSH (`github.com/AkaraChen/nsh-awesome`) is curated and maintained by `AkaraChen` as an independent community catalog and machine-readable index for the Native Shell (`nsh`) ecosystem. While it mirrors and verifies packages from `longbridge/nsh`, `longbridge/nsh-showcases`, `crates.io`, and public GitHub repositories, it is not operated as an official `nsh.dev` product.

All directory pages, README files, `index.json`, and `count.json` are generated deterministically from committed JSON sources (`data/entries.json` and `data/seo-content.json`) inside the public repository, making every inclusion, exclusion, and version update inspectable in Git history.

how.heading: How Discovery, Generation & CI Verification Work
paragraphs: Rather than compiling entries by hand from memory, Awesome NSH operates an automated pipeline inside `scripts/`: `discover.mjs` scans six upstream crates.io and GitHub channels; `lint.mjs` enforces schema completeness, bilingual English/Chinese formatting, and exact entry counts; `generate.mjs` builds synchronized Markdown lists, static HTML pages, and `index.json`; `check-links.mjs` validates upstream URLs; and `verify-install.mjs` creates a clean scratch `nsh.json` project per module and runs the exact `nsh add ...` command on `nsh 0.7.1`.

Whenever `nsh` publishes a new minor or patch release, re-running `verify-install.mjs` and `discover.mjs` surfaces broken version pins (such as crates.io tags still pointing to `^0.6`) before users encounter them.

pipelineScripts.role: Scans 6 external channels (119 crates.io crates, 89 GitHub repos) and checks manifest rules.
Runs `nsh add ...` in clean scratch apps on `nsh 0.7.1` and inspects `nsh.json` + `nsh.lock`.
Validates entry schema fields, heading hierarchy, URL uniqueness, and file parity.
Verifies HTTP reachability for `sourceUrl`, `cratesUrl`, and `homepage` links.
Guards byte-level sync across generated READMEs, static site HTML, `index.json`, and `count.json`.

why.heading: Why This Directory Exists
paragraphs: Native Shell `0.7.1` intentionally keeps its CLI focused on resolving explicit coordinates (`nsh add <crate>`, `github:owner/repo`, or Git URL) without shipping a built-in search registry. Meanwhile, searching `crates.io` or `GitHub` blindly turns up official non-installable framework crates, 40 sub-crates for icon sets, end-user apps with `#[native_module]`, and 0.6-era packages bypassing semver due to Cargo table normalization.
Awesome NSH bridges that gap for developers and coding agents alike by exposing curated human comparisons alongside clean JSON and Markdown endpoints.

criteria.heading: Inclusion & Exclusion Criteria
inclusion: Must install cleanly with `nsh add` inside a fresh scratch app on the current verified `nsh` release (`0.7.1`) from crates.io, `github:owner/repo`, or an explicit Git URL.

Must satisfy `nsh` manifest rules (`#[native_module]` in Rust, `nsh.json` `"exports"` for TSX/Hybrid, or `"platform"` for target backends) and genuinely target `0.7` (excluding normalized `0.6` parser bypasses).

Non-installable official framework crates (`19`), notable templates/apps (`4`), and official documentation tracks (`7`) are segregated into dedicated hubs with explicit `NOT nshm` warnings rather than mixed into `/nshm/`.
exclusion: Packages pinned to `nsh-core 0.6` / `0.6.0` or strict `=0.7.0` pins that fail or only bypass via Cargo's `[dependencies.nsh-core]` normalization quirk.
Ordinary Rust helper crates, CLI binaries, and standalone applications with `publish = false` and `nsh.json` `"root"`/`"id"` keys.
Companion icon-set sub-crates (`40`) and internal gallery data crates (`3`) are documented inside `nsh-icon` and `supernsh-icons` rather than listed individually.

verificationBoundary.heading: Honest Verification Boundary: What Is NOT Tested
verificationBoundary.summary: To prevent misleading claims of universal runtime certification, Awesome NSH explicitly limits its verification badge (`Verified on nsh 0.7.1`) to package installation:
verifiedItems: Running exact `installCommand` (`nsh add ...`) inside a fresh temporary `nsh.json` + `App.tsx` scratch directory on `nsh 0.7.1`.
Checking that `nsh.json` updates `"dependencies"` and `nsh.lock` records the expected package name, version, and source.
Inspecting upstream `Cargo.toml`, `nsh.json`, `src/lib.rs`, and `README.md` directly for manifest semantics and reported platform caveats.
notVerifiedItems: Full native Rust/Swift/Kotlin/WASM/ArkUI compilation across macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, Web, or HarmonyOS targets.
Physical hardware execution, UI rendering checks, performance benchmarks, or upstream test suites (all runtime/benchmark numbers quoted on module pages explicitly cite upstream documentation).
Manual line-by-line cryptographic or security audits of third-party crate code or prebuilt binary artifacts.

securityPolicy.heading: Security Notice for `build.rs`, Proc Macros & Permissions
securityPolicy.body: Installing any Rust, Hybrid, or Platform `nshm` executes its `build.rs` build script, procedural macros (`#[native_module]`), and native libraries with full developer-machine privileges during build and full app permissions at runtime. Crates can also merge Apple `Info.plist` privacy prompts, macOS entitlements, Android manifest permissions/AAR libraries, and HarmonyOS `module.json5` entries via `[package.metadata.nsh]`. Inspect source code, lockfile commit hashes (`nsh.lock`), and generated manifest diffs before shipping.

contributing.heading: How to Submit Updates, Corrections, or New Modules
contributing.body: Maintainers and community contributors can add verified modules, report stale pins (such as when a `0.6` crate upgrades to `0.7` on crates.io), or correct platform caveats by editing `data/entries.json` and `data/seo-content.json`, running `node scripts/generate.mjs`, `node scripts/lint.mjs`, `node --test scripts/verify.test.mjs`, and `node scripts/verify-install.mjs`, and opening a pull request or issue on `github.com/AkaraChen/nsh-awesome`.

zh.title: 关于 Awesome NSH：收录标准、验证边界与安全提示
zh.metaDescription: 了解项目维护者 AkaraChen、nsh 0.7.1 临时应用实测范围、build.rs 与过程宏供应链安全警示，以及向目录提交模块的方式。
zh.h1: 关于 Awesome NSH：维护者、验证范围边界与安全说明
zh.lead: 透明说明由谁维护 Awesome NSH、目录数据如何通过自动化脚本发现与验证，以及“已通过 nsh 0.7.1 验证”具体涵盖与未涵盖哪些测试环节。

who.heading: 维护者信息（Who）
paragraphs: Awesome NSH（`github.com/AkaraChen/nsh-awesome`）由独立开发者 `AkaraChen` 维护，定位为 Native Shell（`nsh`）生态的社区精选清单、交互式网页目录与机器可读索引站点。站内信息核验自 `longbridge/nsh`、`longbridge/nsh-showcases`、crates.io 与各公开 GitHub 仓库，但不代表 `nsh.dev` 官方发布渠道。
全部双语页面、README 文档、`index.json` 与 `count.json` 均由仓库内的 `data/entries.json` 与 `data/seo-content.json` 唯一数据源确定性构建，每一次收录、剔除与版本更新均有公开 Git 提交记录可循。

how.heading: 发现、校验与自动化构建流程（How）
paragraphs: 目录维护不靠手工拼凑信息，而是依靠 `scripts/` 目录下可复现的脚本流水线：`discover.mjs` 扫描 6 条外部数据源、`lint.mjs` 核验字段格式与中英文结尾规范、`generate.mjs` 同步生成 Markdown 与静态网页、`check-links.mjs` 探测在线链接状态，并由 `verify-install.mjs` 在干净临时应用中用真实 `nsh 0.7.1` CLI 执行每一条 `nsh add` 命令。
每当 `nsh` 发布新版本时，重跑这套工具链即可第一时间发现旧版 tag 锁死或解析规则变动带来的安装断裂。

pipelineScripts.role: 横跨 6 条渠道扫描 crates.io（119 个）与 GitHub（89 个）并核对清单规则。
在干净临时 `nsh.json` 目录执行 `nsh add ...`，检验依赖写入与 `nsh.lock` 生成。
检查必填字段、中英文格式规范、标题层级与各生成文件条目数一致性。
批量校验 `sourceUrl`、`cratesUrl` 与 `homepage` 链接可访问性。
确保手改生成物无法通过 CI，守住单一数据源与生成物字节级一致。

why.heading: 项目创立初衷（Why）
paragraphs: `nsh 0.7.1` 命令行专注于根据精确地址安装依赖，未内置 `nsh search` 功能；而在 crates.io 与 GitHub 盲搜又经常踩中不可 `nsh add` 的 19 个官方框架 crate、40 个重复图标子包、带 `#[native_module]` 的完整用户应用，以及利用 Cargo 规范化漏洞绕过检查的 `0.6` 旧包。
Awesome NSH 希望为人类开发者与 AI 编程助手提供一份诚实、结构化且可直接复核源码出处的 `nsh 0.7.1` 生态导航。

criteria.heading: 纳入与拒收标准
inclusion: 必须在当前验证版本（`nsh 0.7.1`）的干净临时应用目录中通过 crates.io、`github:owner/repo` 或显式 Git URL 成功执行 `nsh add`。
必须满足四种合法清单形态之一，且真实依赖 `nsh 0.7`（剔除仅靠 Cargo `[dependencies.nsh-core]` 规范化 quirk 绕过的 `0.6` 包）。
19 个官方框架 crate、4 个应用脚手架与 7 篇官方文档分流到对应独立专栏，并加注醒目“非 nshm”警告，避免误导安装。
exclusion: 锁定 `nsh-core 0.6` / `0.6.0` 或严格锁定 `=0.7.0` 导致在 `0.7.1` 报错或仅靠 parser quirk 蒙混过关的包。
不含 `#[native_module]` 与 `nsh.json` `"exports"` 的普通 Rust 工具 crate、独立 CLI，或标注 `publish = false` 与 `"root"`/`"id"` 的端到端应用。
40 个图标集配套子 crate 与 3 个内部画廊数据包统一收纳到 `nsh-icon` 与 `supernsh-icons` 详情页中说明，不刷屏平铺。

verificationBoundary.heading: 诚实声明：验证范围与未测边界
verificationBoundary.summary: 为避免让读者误以为本站担保全平台编译运行无误，特此明确列出“已测项”与“未测项”边界：
verifiedItems: 在 `nsh 0.7.1` 环境下新建只含 `nsh.json` 与 `App.tsx` 的空白目录，完整执行每条条目的 `installCommand`（`nsh add ...`）。
检查 `nsh.json` `"dependencies"` 与 `nsh.lock` 是否如实记录目标包名、版本号与锁定的源码地址。
逐一核查各模块上游 `Cargo.toml`、`nsh.json`、`src/lib.rs` 与 `README.md`，确保特性名称与平台限制忠实于源码。
notVerifiedItems: 未在 macOS、iOS、Android、Windows、Linux、Web 或鸿蒙目标环境上执行完整的 Rust/Swift/Kotlin/WASM/ArkUI 原生编译。
未在真机硬件上运行界面渲染测试、手势验证或重跑性能压测（各详情页提及的测试或性能数字均明确标明来自上游仓自身报告）。
未对第三方 crate、预编译二进制产物或 GitHub 提交历史逐行进行安全审计。

securityPolicy.heading: `build.rs` 构建脚本、过程宏与供应链安全提示
securityPolicy.body: 安装任意 Rust、混合型或平台型 `nshm` 模块，均意味着在本地编译阶段以当前用户完整权限执行其 `build.rs` 构建脚本与过程宏，并在运行时赋予模块同等于宿主应用的系统能力。模块还可通过 `[package.metadata.nsh]` 自动往应用注入 Apple `Info.plist` 隐私说明、macOS 沙盒 entitlements、Android 清单权限/`aar` 库及鸿蒙 `module.json5` 权限条目。交付前请务必审阅上游仓库与 `nsh.lock` 变动。

contributing.heading: 参与贡献、纠错与新模块提交流程
contributing.body: 若你发布了新的 `nsh 0.7.1` 兼容模块、发现暂缓清单中的 `0.6` 包已升级，或需要修正平台兼容细节，欢迎前往 `github.com/AkaraChen/nsh-awesome` 修改 `data/entries.json` 与 `data/seo-content.json`，在本地运行 `node scripts/generate.mjs`、`node scripts/lint.mjs`、`node --test scripts/verify.test.mjs` 与 `node scripts/verify-install.mjs` 后提交 PR 或 Issue。
